Title: Create a new order with both numeric and boolean measurement parameters and verify they are stored and returned correctly
Preconditions: User is authenticated and has permission to create orders
Expected Result:
1. HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON body containing: {"status": "success", "message": "Order created successfully", "data": {"orderId": <non-null number>}}.
2. HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON body containing the order details, including measurements with both numeric and boolean parameters correctly displayed as in the request.

Title: Update an existing order with both numeric and boolean measurement parameters and verify they are updated correctly

Expected Result:

2. HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON body containing the updated order details, including measurements with updated numeric and boolean parameters as in the request.

Title: Verify that last measurement retrieval correctly handles and exposes measurement type (NUMERIC/BOOLEAN) without leaking internal details
Preconditions: User has at least one order with measurements recorded for a specific item. User is authenticated and authorized to access their own measurements.
Expected Result: The API responds with HTTP status 200 (OK) and a response body containing 'status: success'. The 'data.measurements' array includes objects with 'type' field set to either 'NUMERIC' or 'BOOLEAN', and the corresponding 'value' or 'booleanValue' field populated. No internal system details, Bengali names, or raw database fields are exposed.

Title: Verify that last measurement retrieval rejects null or malformed measurement type values to prevent injection or misrepresentation
Preconditions: User has at least one order with measurements recorded for a specific item. User is authenticated and authorized to access their own measurements.
Expected Result: The API responds with HTTP status 200 (OK) and a response body containing 'status: success'. The 'data.measurements' array includes only valid measurements with 'type' set to either 'NUMERIC' or 'BOOLEAN'. No measurements with null or invalid 'type' are returned. No error messages expose internal system details.

Title: Verify that last measurement retrieval does not expose boolean measurement values as numeric or vice versa (type safety)
Preconditions: User has at least one order with both NUMERIC and BOOLEAN measurements recorded for a specific item. User is authenticated and authorized to access their own measurements.
Expected Result: The API responds with HTTP status 200 (OK) and a response body containing 'status: success'. For measurements with 'type: NUMERIC', the 'value' field is populated and 'booleanValue' is null. For measurements with 'type: BOOLEAN', the 'booleanValue' field is populated and 'value' is null. No measurement exposes both fields simultaneously.

Title: Verify that last measurement retrieval enforces proper authorization for boolean-type measurements (insecure direct object reference)
Preconditions: Two users exist: User A and User B. User A has an order with boolean-type measurements. User B is authenticated but not authorized to access User A's data.
Expected Result: The API responds with HTTP status 403 (Forbidden) or 404 (Not Found), and the response body contains 'status: error' or 'status: fail' with no measurement data returned in the 'data' field.

Title: Verify that order creation rejects malformed measurement type values to prevent injection or misrepresentation
Preconditions: User is authenticated and authorized to create orders. User has a valid shop ID and customer details.
Expected Result: The API responds with HTTP status 400 (Bad Request) and an error message indicating invalid measurement type (e.g., 'Measurement type must be either NUMERIC or BOOLEAN'). No order is created, and no internal system details are exposed.

Title: Verify that order update rejects malformed measurement type values to prevent injection or misrepresentation
Preconditions: User is authenticated and authorized to update an existing order. The order has at least one measurement group.
Expected Result: The API responds with HTTP status 400 (Bad Request) and an error message indicating invalid measurement type (e.g., 'Measurement type must be either NUMERIC or BOOLEAN'). The order is not updated, and no internal system details are exposed.

Title: Verify that order creation enforces type consistency for measurements (NUMERIC must have value, BOOLEAN must have booleanValue)
Preconditions: User is authenticated and authorized to create orders. User has a valid shop ID and customer details.
Expected Result: The API responds with HTTP status 400 (Bad Request) and an error message indicating that NUMERIC measurements require a 'value' and BOOLEAN measurements require a 'booleanValue'. No order is created, and no internal system details are exposed.

Title: Verify that order update enforces type consistency for measurements (NUMERIC must have value, BOOLEAN must have booleanValue)
Preconditions: User is authenticated and authorized to update an existing order. The order has at least one measurement group.
Expected Result: The API responds with HTTP status 400 (Bad Request) and an error message indicating that NUMERIC measurements require a 'value' and BOOLEAN measurements require a 'booleanValue'. The order is not updated, and no internal system details are exposed.

Title: Verify that last measurement retrieval does not expose measurement type in unauthorized contexts (e.g., Bengali-only users)
Preconditions: User is authenticated and authorized to access last measurements but is configured to view Bengali-only content. User has at least one order with measurements recorded for a specific item.
Expected Result: The API responds with HTTP status 200 (OK) and a response body containing 'status: success'. The 'data.measurements' array includes measurement objects with 'nameBn' populated, but the 'type' field is either omitted or set to a value that does not expose internal system details (e.g., not 'NUMERIC' or 'BOOLEAN').
